text:
samir: Running the new samplekit-rag starter and hitting duplicate backend calls when the auth token expires and the SDK retries. Seen on local edge dev and hosted demo.

maria: oh no. short repro? :eyes:

samir: repro = start samplekit, call /api/complete with an expired token, SDK does retry, result: two inflight requests in serving logs but app only shows one response.

samir: log snippet: `POST /v1/generate -> 401` then retry, but client-side KV prefix cache had an inflight marker so runtime processes both requests.

maria: can you paste the client call? might need idempotency header.

samir:```js
// client snippet
const resp = await redwoodClient.generate({
  model: 'redwood/fast-lite',
  prompt: promptText,
  retry: { max: 2, backoff: 150 }
});
```

aj: this matches the SDK-parity note: Node SDK auto-adds `x-idempotency-key` for retries, browser/edge client doesn't yet. Runtime sees different keys -> treated as distinct requests.

aj: short-term: add idempotency header at app level while we ship parity. e.g. `headers: { 'x-idempotency-key': crypto.randomUUID() }` and reuse across retry attempts.

devon: FYI the starter's KV cache uses a fingerprint that doesn't include idempotency header. It uses request fingerprint + inflight marker. If header differs, inflight check misses and duplicates occur. Two options: include idempotency in fingerprint when present, or keep header stable across retries.

samir: i'll try header workaround. also noticed CI evals failing on this flow: `evals/llama-rag/seed-embed-parity` flaky after auth-retry events. ci-bot shows failures.

ci-bot: deploy/system: 3 failed eval runs in last 3 hours for branch samplekit/retry-patch. Details: https://ci.internal.redwood/evals/1756 (truncated).

maria: we should add an e2e test to starter tests that simulates expired token and ensures no duplicate upstream calls. Put in `tests/retry.spec.ts` and mock the serving endpoint to count POSTs.

aj: i'll open a small PR to: 1) add idempotency header in the edge client, 2) add e2e that simulates 401 then success, 3) update starter README with a note about auth+retry and KV inflight markers.

devon: for the long term, runtime should consider idempotency header in inflight fingerprint only when present, but be careful with privacy/headers. Maybe a dedicated `x-rw-idempotency` header the runtime knows to trust.

samir: patch preview (local test) below. it sets header and reuses it across retries. will push PR if green. :thumbsup:

samir: ```diff
- await redwoodClient.generate({ ... })
+ const id = crypto.randomUUID()
+ await redwoodClient.generate({ ... , headers: { 'x-idempotency-key': id } })
```

maria: looks good. once aj's PR lands, we can remove the hack in samplekit. Also add a short note in starter README and the devex FAQ.

aj: opened PR #4287 with edge client change and tests. tagging @devon for runtime fingerprint thought.

devon: will review this afternoon. also adding a quick telemetry metric to count duplicate inflight detections to track regressions.

samir: thanks all. leaving this thread with the temp workaround in README and CI e2e to catch regressions. :rocket:
